params.name: id
params.description: Filter items by ID.

params.description: Filter items by name.

params.name: mpn
params.description: Filter items by Manufacturer Part Number (MPN).

params.name: upc
params.description: Filter items by UPC.

params.name: price
params.description: Filter items by price.

params.name: weight
params.description: Filter items by weight.

params.name: condition
params.description: Filter items by condition.

params.name: brand_id
params.description: Filter items by brand_id.

params.name: date_modified
params.description: Filter items by `date_modified`.

params.name: date_modified:max
params.description: Filter items by `date_modified`. For example, `date_modified:max=2020-06-15`.

params.name: date_modified:min
params.description: Filter items by `date_modified`. For example, `date_modified:min=2018-06-15`.

params.name: date_last_imported
params.description: Filter items by date_last_imported.

params.name: date_last_imported:not
params.description: Filter items by date_last_imported. For example, `date_last_imported:not=2015-08-21T22%3A53%3A23%2B00%3A00`.

params.name: date_last_imported:max
params.description: Filter items by date_last_imported. For example, `date_last_imported:max=2015-08-21T22%3A53%3A23%2B00%3A00`.

params.name: date_last_imported:min
params.description: Filter items by date_last_imported. For example, `date_last_imported:min=2015-08-21T22%3A53%3A23%2B00%3A00`.

params.name: is_visible
params.description: Filter items based on whether the product is currently visible on the storefront.

params.name: is_featured
params.description: Filter items by is_featured. `1` for true, `0` for false.

params.name: is_free_shipping
params.description: Filter items by is_free_shipping. `1` for true, `0` for false.

params.name: inventory_level
params.description: Filter items by inventory_level.

params.name: inventory_low
params.description: Filter items by inventory_low. Values: 1, 0.

params.name: out_of_stock
params.description: Filter items by out_of_stock. To enable the filter, pass `out_of_stock`=`1`.

params.name: total_sold
params.description: Filter items by total_sold.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter items by type.

params.name: categories
params.description:
Filter items by categories.
 If a product is in more than one category, using this query will not return the product. Instead use `categories:in=12`.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Filter items by keywords found in the `name` or `sku` fields

params.name: keyword_context
params.description: Set context used by the search algorithm to return results targeted towards the specified group. Use `merchant` to help merchants search their own catalog. Use `shopper` to return shopper-facing search results.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter items by status.

params.name: include
params.description:
Sub-resources to include on a product, in a comma-separated list. If `options` or `modifiers` is used, results are limited to 10 per page.

**Note:** The following sub-resources include:
  * variants
  * images
  * custom_fields
  * bulk_pricing_rules
  * primary_image
  * modifiers
  * options
  * videos

params.name: include_fields
params.description: Fields to include, in a comma-separated list. The ID and the specified fields will be returned.

params.name: exclude_fields
params.description: Fields to exclude, in a comma-separated list. The specified fields will be excluded from a response. The ID cannot be excluded.

params.name: availability
params.description: Filter items by availability. Values are: available, disabled, preorder.

params.name: page
params.description: Specifies the page number in a limited (paginated) list of products.

params.name: limit
params.description: Controls the number of items per page in a limited (paginated) list of products. The default product limit is 50 with a maximum limit of 250.

params.name: direction
params.description: Sort direction. Acceptable values are: `asc`, `desc`.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field name to sort by. Note: Since `id` increments when new products are added, you can use that field to sort by product create date.

params.name: categories:in
params.description: Filter items by categories. Use for products in multiple categories. For example, `categories:in=12,15`.

params.name: sku
params.description: Filter items by main SKU. To filter by variant SKU, see [Get All Variants](/docs/rest-catalog/product-variants#get-all-product-variants).

params.name: sku:in
params.description: Filter items by SKU.

items.docs:
Creates a *Product*. Only one product can be created at a time; however, you can create multiple product variants using the `variants` array.

**Required Fields:**
- `name`
- `type`
- `weight`
- `price`

**Read-Only Fields**
- `id`
- `date_created`
- `date_modified`
- `calculated_price`
- `base_variant_id`

**Limits**
- 250 characters product name length.
- A product can have up to 1000 images. Each image file or image uploaded by URL can be up to 8 MB.

Updates products in batches. Batches are limited to 10 products.

**Required Fields**
* `id` - product `id` is required for batch updates to products.

**Read-Only Fields**
- `id`
- `date_created`
- `date_modified`
- `calculated_price`
- `base_variant_id`

items.docs:
To delete *Product* objects, you must include a filter. This prevents inadvertently deleting all *Product* objects in a store.

> #### Note
> The maximum number of products you can delete at one time is 250.

**Example**:
To delete products with IDs 1,2 and 3, use `DELETE /v3/catalog/products?id:in=1,2,3`.
